mapper.insert:
SELECT LEARNING_OBSERVATIONS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LEARNING_OBSERVATIONS ( ID, LESSON_REPORT_ID, CATEGORY, ITEM, MEMO ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{lessonReportId}, #{category}, #{item}, #{memo} )
mapper.select: SELECT O.ID, O.LESSON_REPORT_ID, O.CATEGORY, O.ITEM, O.MEMO, O.CREATED_AT, O.UPDATED_AT FROM LEARNING_OBSERVATIONS O INNER JOIN LESSON_REPORTS R ON O.LESSON_REPORT_ID = R.ID INNER JOIN LESSONS L ON R.LESSON_ID = L.ID INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE O.LESSON_REPORT_ID = #{lessonReportId} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} ORDER BY O.ID ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE LEARNING_OBSERVATIONS SET CATEGORY = #{observation.category}, ITEM = #{observation.item}, MEMO = #{observation.memo}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_DATE WHERE ID = #{observation.id} AND LESSON_REPORT_ID = #{lessonReportId} AND LESSON_REPORT_ID IN ( SELECT R.ID FROM LESSON_REPORTS R INNER JOIN LESSONS L ON R.LESSON_ID = L.ID INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON L.STUDENT_ID = S.ID WHERE S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT O.ID, PREVIOUS_LESSON.ID AS "lessonId", PREVIOUS_LESSON.LESSON_AT AS "lessonAt", O.CATEGORY, O.ITEM, O.MEMO FROM LESSONS CURRENT_LESSON INNER JOIN STUDENTS S ON CURRENT_LESSON.STUDENT_ID = S.ID INNER JOIN LESSONS PREVIOUS_LESSON ON PREVIOUS_LESSON.STUDENT_ID = CURRENT_LESSON.STUDENT_ID INNER JOIN LESSON_REPORTS R ON R.LESSON_ID = PREVIOUS_LESSON.ID INNER JOIN LEARNING_OBSERVATIONS O ON O.LESSON_REPORT_ID = R.ID WHERE CURRENT_LESSON.ID = #{lessonId} AND S.INSTRUCTOR_ID = #{instructorId} AND PREVIOUS_LESSON.LESSON_AT < CURRENT_LESSON.LESSON_AT
ORDER BY PREVIOUS_LESSON.LESSON_AT DESC, PREVIOUS_LESSON.ID DESC, O.ID ASC
